text:
Just opened a new business? Start with your Google Business Profile.

Right main category. Real photos. Verified.

Google even lets you add an opening date up to 90 days ahead, so a new cafe in Mount Lawley can be on the map before the doors open.

Then ask every happy customer for a review.

Google says local rankings come down to relevance, distance and prominence.

You can't move your shop. SEO works on the other two: clear pages on what you do, a complete profile, real reviews.

So when someone searches "plumber Joondalup", you've got a real shot at being the one they ring.

A 12-month lock-in with a marketer is like a mechanic holding your car keys until next year.

If the work's good, you'll come back anyway.
If the work's poor, you should be free to go.

I don't do lock-ins. If it stops working for you, you stop.

No drama. No games.
